title: Ladybug dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dancing ladybug, tilted pose with raised arms/legs -->
  <!-- legs (raised, motion) -->
  <g stroke='#2b1a0e' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'>
    <line x1='40' y1='42' x2='26' y2='30'/>
    <line x1='42' y1='52' x2='22' y2='50'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='62' x2='28' y2='70'/>
    <line x1='60' y1='42' x2='74' y2='28'/>
    <line x1='58' y1='52' x2='78' y2='50'/>
    <line x1='56' y1='62' x2='72' y2='72'/>
  </g>
  <!-- body shell (red wings) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='22' ry='24' fill='#e8392b'/>
  <!-- wing split -->
  <line x1='50' y1='30' x2='50' y2='75' stroke='#a81f14' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- lighter rim on shell for edge definition -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='22' ry='24' fill='none' stroke='#ff7b6e' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='45' r='3.5' fill='#2b1a0e'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='45' r='3.5' fill='#2b1a0e'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='59' r='3.5' fill='#2b1a0e'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='59' r='3.5' fill='#2b1a0e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='3' fill='#2b1a0e'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='27' r='11' fill='#2b1a0e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='27' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#4a3324' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- happy eyes -->
  <path d='M44 25 q2 -3 4 0' stroke='#fff' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 25 q2 -3 4 0' stroke='#fff' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 31 q4 2 8 0' stroke='#fff' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M44 18 q-4 -6 -9 -8' stroke='#2b1a0e' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 18 q4 -6 9 -8' stroke='#2b1a0e' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='10' r='2.5' fill='#2b1a0e'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='10' r='2.5' fill='#2b1a0e'/>
  <!-- dance sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe14d'>
    <path d='M20 22 l2 5 l5 2 l-5 2 l-2 5 l-2 -5 l-5 -2 l5 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M80 20 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5 -4 l-4 -1.5 l4 -1.5 z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
